name: hook-security-mcp
description: Read Hook Security phishing and training data, and answer the cross-client questions an MSP actually asks.

hook_security_base_url.title: Hook API URL
hook_security_base_url.description: Sets HOOK_SECURITY_BASE_URL. Leave at the default unless Hook tells you otherwise.

hook_security_api_key.title: Hook API key
hook_security_api_key.description: Sets HOOK_SECURITY_API_KEY. An admin creates it in Hook under Settings > API keys. See https://docs.hooksecurity.co/docs/integrations/connect-your-ai-assistant.

hook_security_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
hook_security_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

hook_security_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
hook_security_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 to remove the tools that write local files (sync, export and the local learning tools). No tool can change anything in Hook either way. Preset to 1.

hook_security_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
hook_security_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: a value here does not limit which organizations a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit access, use an organization key instead of an MSP key.

hook_security_no_local_data.title: No local data
hook_security_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of Hook data: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync is refused. Leave blank for the default.
